An orc shaman guards his treasure in a small orc outpost in the swamps east of Venore. Open the hidden hole with the shovel, go down into the {wiki:Venore Orc Cave|Venore Orc Cave}, kill the {creature:Orc Shaman} and his companions and open the box to receive a {item:Magic Light Wand}, an {item:Axe Ring} and a {item:Blank Rune}.
An orc shaman guards his treasure in a small orc outpost near Venore.
Small cave in the swamps east of Venore
Does not need Premium and has no minimum level (level 20+ recommended).
Do not forget the {item:Shovel}: without it you cannot open the cave hole.
{creature:Snake|Snakes} poison you: bring something to cure poison if you are a low level.
In **Venore** (if you come by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to your city's captain), leave through the **south** gate of the city and head **east**, crossing the swamp to a small cave.
Small cave (hole to open with the shovel)
Right path through the swamp to the cave
Use the {item:Shovel} to open the hole and go down through it.
Once in the cave, head straight **east** and go down one floor.

On this floor there are many {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and an {creature:Orc Shaman}. The quest chest is in the **southeast** corner of the room. Kill the monsters and open it.

Go back the same way: go up to the floor above where you came down (use the {item:Rope} if it is a hole), head **west** to the hole you came in through and climb up again with the {item:Rope} to the swamp. Then go back **west** to Venore's south gate.
Cave hole (climb up with the Rope)
